definitions.gloss: to surround; to encircle; to gather around
definitions.explanation: For people or things to form a ring or group around someone or something. Can describe a physical surrounding or a more figurative gathering around a central point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}んだ。
⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}んで⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sit around the table and eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}んで⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}いだ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: The police surrounded the building to prevent the suspect from escaping.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (intensifying prefix from ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧) and ⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (to surround). The ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ prefix adds a sense of completeness or thoroughness to the surrounding action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む: to surround a person
- ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む: to gather around a table
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む: to surround a building
- ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む: to surround in large numbers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to surround — simpler form, also used figuratively for enjoying things together (e.g., ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧)
- ⟦{包囲|ほうい}する→包囲する：19707_houisuru⟧: to besiege, to lay siege — more formal and military
- {取|と}り{巻|ま}く: to surround — often used for circumstances or environment
